```{r constants}
# Lineage groupings
epi_types     <- c("Ciliated epithelium", "SecA epithelium",
                    "Transitioning epithelium", "SecB epithelium")
immune_types  <- c("T cell", "NK cell", "B cell", "Plasma cell",
                    "Macrophage", "Conventional dendritic cell",
                    "Plasmacytoid dendritic cell", "Neutrophil", "Mast cell")
stromal_types <- c("Fibroblast", "Smooth muscle", "Mesothelial",
                    "Pericyte", "Endothelial")

# Ordered cell types (epithelial → stromal → immune)
celltype_order <- c(epi_types, stromal_types, immune_types)

nb_levels <- paste0("nb_", 1:10)

# KM palette (Low = blue, High = orange)
km_pal <- c("Low" = "#0072B2", "High" = "#D55E00")
```

# 1. Load Data

```{r load-sfe}
# Load filtered TMA SFE and extract colData
sfe_tma <- load_sfe("sfe_tma_filtered")
tma_dt <- data.table(
  cell_id     = colnames(sfe_tma),
  cell_label  = sfe_tma$cell_label,
  cell_area   = sfe_tma$cell_area,
  core_id     = as.character(sfe_tma$core_id),
  patient_id  = as.character(sfe_tma$patient_id),
  sample_type = sfe_tma$sample_type
)
rm(sfe_tma); gc(verbose = FALSE)

# Keep only tumour cells with valid core_id
tma_dt <- tma_dt[sample_type == "tumour" & !is.na(core_id)]
cat("Tumour cells:", format(nrow(tma_dt), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Cores:", length(unique(tma_dt$core_id)), "\n")
cat("Patients:", length(unique(tma_dt$patient_id)), "\n")
```

```{r load-neighborhoods}
# Load neighborhood assignments for TMA
nb_assign <- fread(file.path(out_dir, "09_neighborhood/neighborhood_assignments_k10.csv"))
nb_assign <- nb_assign[sample_id == "sfe_tma_filtered"]
nb_assign[, sample_id := NULL]

# Merge
tma_dt <- merge(tma_dt, nb_assign[, .(cell_id, neighborhood)],
                by = "cell_id", all.x = TRUE)
cat("Cells with neighborhood:", sum(!is.na(tma_dt$neighborhood)), "/",
    nrow(tma_dt), "\n")
cat("Unassigned:", sum(is.na(tma_dt$neighborhood) |
                        tma_dt$neighborhood == "nb_unassigned"), "\n")
```

```{r load-clinical}
# Clinical data
clinical <- fread(file.path(data_dir, "clinical_data_clean.csv"))
clinical[, patient_id := as.character(patient_id)]
cat("Clinical patients:", nrow(clinical), "\n")

# Check overlap
tma_patients <- unique(tma_dt$patient_id)
clin_patients <- clinical$patient_id
shared <- intersect(tma_patients, clin_patients)
cat("Shared patients (TMA ∩ clinical):", length(shared), "\n")
```

# 2. Per-Patient Features {.tabset}

## 2a. Cell type densities

```{r compute-density}
# Per-core: total tissue area (mm²) and cell counts per type
core_area <- tma_dt[, .(total_area_mm2 = sum(cell_area, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e6),
                    by = core_id]

core_counts <- dcast(tma_dt, core_id ~ cell_label,
                     fun.aggregate = length, value.var = "cell_id", fill = 0)

# Compute density (cells/mm²) per core per type
core_density <- merge(core_counts, core_area, by = "core_id")
dens_cols <- intersect(celltype_order, names(core_density))
for (ct in dens_cols) {
  set(core_density, j = ct,
      value = core_density[[ct]] / core_density$total_area_mm2)
}

# Map core → patient
core_patient <- unique(tma_dt[, .(core_id, patient_id)])
core_density <- merge(core_density, core_patient, by = "core_id")

# Average across cores per patient
patient_density <- core_density[patient_id %in% shared,
  lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = patient_id,
  .SDcols = dens_cols
]

# Rename columns
setnames(patient_density, dens_cols,
         paste0("dens_", gsub(" ", "_", dens_cols)))

cat("Patient density matrix:", nrow(patient_density), "patients x",
    ncol(patient_density) - 1, "cell types\n")
```

## 2b. Neighborhood proportions

```{r compute-nb-proportion}
# Per-core: total cells and cells per neighborhood
core_n <- tma_dt[, .(n_total = .N), by = core_id]
nb_dt  <- tma_dt[!is.na(neighborhood) & neighborhood != "nb_unassigned"]

core_nb <- dcast(nb_dt, core_id ~ neighborhood,
                 fun.aggregate = length, value.var = "cell_id", fill = 0)
core_nb <- merge(core_nb, core_n, by = "core_id")

# Compute proportions
nb_present <- intersect(nb_levels, names(core_nb))
for (nb in nb_present) {
  set(core_nb, j = nb, value = core_nb[[nb]] / core_nb$n_total)
}

# Map core → patient, average
core_nb <- merge(core_nb, core_patient, by = "core_id")
patient_nb <- core_nb[patient_id %in% shared,
  lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = patient_id,
  .SDcols = nb_present
]

# Rename
setnames(patient_nb, nb_present,
         paste0("prop_", nb_present))

cat("Patient neighborhood matrix:", nrow(patient_nb), "patients x",
    ncol(patient_nb) - 1, "neighborhoods\n")
```

## 2c. Merge with clinical data

```{r merge-features}
# Merge density + neighborhood + clinical
per_patient <- merge(patient_density, patient_nb, by = "patient_id")
per_patient <- merge(per_patient, clinical, by = "patient_id")

# 5-year censoring
per_patient[, os_time_5y  := pmin(survival_months, 60)]
per_patient[, os_event_5y := fifelse(survival_months > 60, 0L,
                                     as.integer(survival_outcome))]
per_patient[, pfs_time_5y  := pmin(progression_months, 60)]
per_patient[, pfs_event_5y := fifelse(progression_months > 60, 0L,
                                      as.integer(progression_outcome))]

# Feature lists
dens_features <- grep("^dens_", names(per_patient), value = TRUE)
nb_features   <- grep("^prop_", names(per_patient), value = TRUE)
all_features  <- c(dens_features, nb_features)

cat("Final cohort:", nrow(per_patient), "patients\n")
cat("Features:", length(all_features), "(", length(dens_features),
    "density +", length(nb_features), "neighborhood)\n")
cat("5-yr OS events:", sum(per_patient$os_event_5y), "/",
    nrow(per_patient), "\n")
cat("5-yr PFS events:", sum(per_patient$pfs_event_5y), "/",
    nrow(per_patient), "\n")

# Save
fwrite(per_patient, file.path(clin_dir, "per_patient_features.csv"))
```
